chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah from 'Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no harm in praying on the model/image if you place it beneath you."
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray on a model or image in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the permissibility of using a 'misal' (model/image/object) as a prayer surface, provided it is placed directly under the worshipper, thereby ensuring the validity of prostration on a clean surface. It reflects the Shia juristic focus on the physical conditions of *sujood*, distinguishing between the object itself and its placement relative to the body to avoid invalidating the prayer through impurity or improper contact.
